no_automute_checkbox: Do not mute when other apps play audio (--noautomute)
kwin_hint: Note: If the wallpaper window stays on top, you may need to create a KWin rule (Alt+F3 -> More Actions -> Configure Special Window Settings) to force it 'Keep Below'.
stop_on_exit_checkbox: Stop wallpapers when exiting the app
status_error_empty_id: Status: Error! Wallpaper ID cannot be empty.
status_error_launch_command: Status: Error! Failed to launch command:
status_all_stopped: Status: All wallpaper engine processes stopped.
status_no_processes_found: Status: No processes found or pkill failed.
preview_placeholder: Select a wallpaper from the list for preview
status_no_wallpaper_dir: Status: Wallpaper Engine directory not found.
status_selected_wallpaper_id: Status: Wallpaper ID {id} selected. Click 'Set' on Control tab.
status_properties_none: Status: No properties found for this wallpaper.
monitors_help: Enable the outputs you want, set a wallpaper ID or path per output, and choose scaling/clamping per screen. The backend is invoked like: --screen-root OUTPUT --bg ID [--scaling …] [--clamp …] for each enabled row.
status_displays_refreshed: Status: Display list updated from the system.
status_no_enabled_displays: Enable at least one output and enter a wallpaper ID or path for it.
wp_settings_help: Pick an output that has a wallpaper ID on the Control tab, then load properties from the engine. Adjust controls below, save, and apply. If two different wallpapers share a property name, the last one in the command wins (engine limitation).
wp_no_wallpaper_for_screen: No wallpaper ID on enabled outputs. Set IDs on Control first.
wp_click_load_hint: Click “Load properties from engine” to fetch adjustable fields for this wallpaper.
wp_push_wallpaper_to_all_enabled: Use this ID on all enabled outputs
wp_pushed_id_all_status: Status: Wallpaper ID and properties applied on all enabled outputs.
set_wallpaper_all_screens_status: Status: Applied wallpaper {id} to {count} enabled output(s).
set_wallpaper_all_screens_no_selection: Status: Select a wallpaper in the list first.
